messages:
Nina: Quick sync 1: we want a compact social push for the launch: X announcement image + follow-up thread with a 20s demo clip, and LinkedIn longform the next day. Need two headline variants, video trimmed to 18-22s, and clear hubspot routing. Can design pick up by Mon midday?
Ravi: I can do the image + trim the clip. Which stat to highlight on the image: throughput uplift or cost reduction?
Claire: Use cost reduction on the hero ("~40% lower inference cost") and put throughput in the thread. That should appeal to procurement + engineers.
Jordan: I'll write headline A (metrics-first) and B (customer result). Also provide three short CTAs for A/B test.
Nina: Great. Tracking: utm_campaign=launch_may, utm_content=A or B. All webinar signups must create HubSpot contact with property "social_series" and variant value. Ops to confirm mapping.
marketing-bot: Reminder: include property key "social_variant" in the registration form. Auto-checklist created.
Ravi: Uploaded draft files: https://files.redwood/launch/hero_cost.png and https://files.redwood/launch/demo_trim.mp4. Clip trimmed to 19s, needs end-frame CTA.
Jordan: I'll add end-frame CTA text and a 1.5s hold. Also drop music slightly.
Claire: Draft LinkedIn longform posted: https://docs.redwood/launch_longform. Two options available. Add product quote?
Nina: Product quote would help. Pinged product for 2 short lines.
Jordan: Proposed post schedule: X announcement Tue 9:30am PT, follow-up thread 2h later with demo, LinkedIn longform Wed 10am PT. Buffer scheduling ok?
Ravi: Works for me. I'll label files hero_A/hero_B and clip_A/clip_B for analytics mapping.
marketing-bot: HubSpot workflow created and test contact routed to #sales-inbound. Fields: tag=launch_may, social_variant=A.
Nina: Nice. For engagement follow-ups: write 3 reply templates (thank you, demo invite, webinar reminder). Jordan take?
Jordan: On it. I'll post templates in the doc later today.
Claire: One last note: compress clip for X (<15MB) and keep 720p. Ravi can transcode.
Ravi: Done, small file uploaded. Ready for final approval.
Nina: Thanks team 680 I'll review and approve tonight.
